text:
aj: Heads-up — noticed an uptick in streaming tail latency during the 03:12 canary. Chunk cadence has much higher jitter than baseline, and we’re seeing short server-side stalls (~50–200ms) that line up with KV sampling spikes. :eyes:

mira: Which metric is the best signal here? chunk_emit_interval_p95 or the stream_chunk_gap histogram?

thomas: chunk_emit_interval_p95 + stream_chunk_gap_bucket helps. Also look at token_latency_breakdown (decode / execute / network). I dumped a quick PromQL that helped me correlate: ```sum(rate(stream_chunk_gap_bucket[5m])) by (le, route)```

lina: grafana link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/streaming/streaming-instrumentation?orgId=1&var-route=all — the panel I just added shows client_ts vs server_ts alignment. Server-side stamp jumps line up with a kernel-switch on the canary node.

aj: I ran `kubectl logs` for the canary pod and saw the runtime choose `kernel_v2_fastpath` then fall back to `kernel_v1` for a few requests: ```2026-03-17T03:12:42Z INFO kernel: selected kernel_v2_fastpath for model:gptx seq:128
2026-03-17T03:12:42Z WARN kernel: fallback to kernel_v1 exec_ms=48 reason=quant_error```

mira: That fallback pattern will increase per-token execute time and cause KV pressure. We sample KV reads at 1% by default; can we increase sampling to 5% in prod for a short window to get more visibility?

thomas: I can flip a feature flag on the runtime to `kv_sample_ratio=0.05` for the impacted nodes. Also will add a histogram panel for kv_read_ms and kv_hit_rate by route.

lina: Also adding a token-level latency breakdown panel (decode_ms / execute_ms / network_ms) per-route should make regressions obvious. Can we annotate the dashboard when the canary switched kernels so we don't chase unrelated noise?

aj: Yes — adding an annotation at 1850012260 (canary kernel toggle). Also creating an alert: streaming_chunk_gap_p95 > 120ms for 10m should page eng-oncall.

ops-bot: Scheduled job: increase-kv-sampling run on canary nodes at 03:40 by thomas — SUCCESS

deploy-bot: Canary deploy 2026-03-17T03:10 completed for runtime-canary-7 — 1 warning (kernel fallback observed)

mira: Quick note: client vs server timing mismatch was partly because client-side timestamps were coarse (ms resolution), sending a patch to add monotonic microtime stamps to the client SDK. Once that's in, we can separate network vs server stalls better.

thomas: Action items: 1) Increase KV sampling to 5% for 30m (done) 2) Add kv_read_ms and kv_hit_rate panels per-route (in progress) 3) Add token-level decode/execute/network panels (in progress) 4) Backfill canary kernel selection logs into tracing index for correlation.

lina: Filed PERF-1529 to track follow-ups and dashboards. I'll post the dashboard snapshot in the ticket. :white_check_mark:

aj: Thanks — let's monitor for another 2h and decide if the kernel selector needs a safety throttle (don’t switch kernels mid-request unless certain).
